summary: MYR Group Inc. filed a Form 8-K on September 10, 2026, disclosing that on September 8, 2026 it entered a five-year Fourth Amended and Restated Credit Agreement led by JPMorgan Chase, Bank of America and Wells Fargo. The facility provides a $690 million revolver, a $150 million USD term tranche and a C$70 million Canadian term tranche, with an accordion up to $445 million. Proceeds refinance existing debt and fund working capital, capex and acquisitions. This is a routine credit-facility refinancing, not a special situation.
